name: Young brush keeper
design: Small athletic young adult female Yautja with warm golden freckled hide, broad rear skull, four small distinct mandibles and compact thick tendrils tied high with one pale bone ring. Rust-orange short work wrap over charcoal undershirt, dark skirt panels over leg wraps, diagonal tool pouch. Holds a round currycomb in left clawed hand and a long-handled soft brush lowered in right. Quiet energetic standing pose.
